methodology_other: Change detection on synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images acquired before and after the event. Damage Proxy Maps show significant changes in radar coherence and amplitude; Flood Proxy Maps show areas that changed to standing water. Maps are preliminary and checked against news reports and ground-level imagery where available.

# Morocco Floods: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Feb 2026

The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage and flood proxy maps for Morocco Floods (Feb 2026) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it.

## Maps in this dataset

- **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Morocco, Floods, 08 Feb 2026, v0.8**
- **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Morocco, Floods, 08 Feb 2026, v0.8**

organization.description: The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) is a research lab at Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore. It uses satellite remote sensing, mainly synthetic aperture radar (SAR), to map natural hazards and disasters. The lab produces Damage Proxy Maps (DPMs) and Flood Proxy Maps (FPMs) showing where damage or flooding has likely occurred. Its work focuses on Southeast Asia and the wider Asia-Pacific, and it also responds to major disasters worldwide.

resources.description:
EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Morocco, Floods, 08 Feb 2026, v0.8

ZIP containing: GeoTIFF, KMZ, PNG, TXT.

The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) created this preliminary Damage Proxy Map (DPM), which highlights areas likely damaged in Morocco due to Storms Kristin, Leonardo, and Marta in late January to early February 2026. This map was derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images acquired by the Copernicus Sentinel-1 satellite operated by the European Space Agency (ESA) before (17 Oct 2025 to 21 Jan 2026) and after (08 Feb 2026) the event.

EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Morocco, Floods, 08 Feb 2026, v0.8

ZIP containing: GeoTIFF, KMZ, PNG, TXT, Shapefile.

The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) created this preliminary Flood Proxy Map (FPM) depicting areas that are likely flooded in Morocco due to Storm Kristin, Leonardo, and Marta. This map was derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images acquired by the Copernicus Sentinel-1 satellite operated by the European Space Agency (ESA) before (5 Sep 2025 to 21 Jan 2026) and after (08 Feb 2026) the event.
